articles.availability_note: Catch-up addition first published November 18, 2026 (Hong Kong time). NASA’s November 13 presentation revisits research reported in June 2026. The global Landsat study covers 1984–2023; its roughly 2010 turning point differs from the local February 2026 image date. Recent net growth does not erase earlier losses or establish mature ecological function everywhere. IUCN’s local water-flow account is dated 2018. Figures and interpretations are attributed to the inspected institutional sources; underlying maps and the publisher full text were not independently reanalysed here.
